name: deploy-checklist
description: Shows a pre-deploy checklist (tests, branch, changelog) and asks you to confirm before deploying.

branches.title: Release branches
branches.description: Comma-separated branches deploys may go out from.

extraPattern.title: Extra deploy pattern
extraPattern.description: A regex for more deploy commands to gate (for example: git push heroku|./scripts/release.sh). Empty: only the built-in list.

confirmWhenPassing.title: Confirm even when everything passes
confirmWhenPassing.description: Ask before every deploy. Off: a deploy whose checklist is all green runs straight away.
